proposed.sourceName: Halal Monitoring Committee (HMC UK) — 'HMC Criteria for Halal'
proposed.paraphrase: HMC requires every animal to be hand-slaughtered by a practicing Muslim with the Tasmiyah recited over each one, prohibits all machine/mechanical slaughter and all stunning, and requires the animal to be alive and healthy at slaughter — fully meeting the zabiha (hand-slaughtered only) bar. (Standing criteria, accessed 2026-07-01.)

researcherNote: HMC = hand-slaughter, no-stun, Tasmiyah on each animal (its own published criteria) → genuinely satisfies all four positions. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
